title: Small uppercase label
summary: text-transform and letter-spacing make a small "eyebrow" label above a heading.
explanation: The label is written in normal case in the HTML and shown in capitals by text-transform: uppercase, so screen readers and copy-paste still get the real words.
Capitals set tightly look cramped, especially when small. letter-spacing: 0.08em opens them up; em keeps the spacing proportional to the font size.
Small, spaced, coloured capitals read as a label rather than as shouting.
tryThis: Remove letter-spacing from .eyebrow: the capitals crowd together.
Change text-transform to none: the label loses its 'label' look.
Change letter-spacing to 0.3em: past a point it falls apart into separate letters.
